title: We Should Have Said Something
gist_ar: مشهد: هي عايزة تسمع 'إحنا مجرّبناش'، مش 'مكانش هينفع'.

before_listening.en: Two colleagues after something has gone wrong. Listen for what she finally gets him to ACCEPT.
before_listening.ar: زميلين بعد ما حصلت مشكلة. ركّز على إيه اللي هي خلّته يعترف بيه في الآخر.

segments.speaker: Layla
segments.text: If we'd said something in April, none of this would have happened.

segments.speaker: Sami
segments.text: That's not true, and you know it isn't. Because if we'd said something in April, they would have moved us both off the project and given it to Hana, and Hana would have signed exactly the same thing. It wouldn't have changed the outcome. It would have changed who was standing here.

segments.speaker: Layla
segments.text: So your position is that it wouldn't have mattered.

segments.speaker: Sami
segments.text: My position is that it wouldn't have worked. Those aren't the same thing.

segments.speaker: Sami
segments.text: Look. If I'd known in April what I know now, I'd have gone to the board directly. I would have. But in April all I had was a feeling that the numbers were too clean.

segments.speaker: Layla
segments.text: You told me they were too clean. In the car park. You said nobody's costs come in that tidy.

segments.speaker: Layla
segments.text: And I said we should check. And you said, let's see what the second quarter looks like.

segments.speaker: Sami
segments.text: Which was a reasonable thing to say in April.

segments.speaker: Layla
segments.text: It was a reasonable thing to say if you wanted to not know for another three months. That's what it was for. If either of us had genuinely thought the numbers were fine, we wouldn't have needed to wait for the second quarter to find out.

segments.speaker: Sami
segments.text: That's a hard way to put it.

segments.speaker: Layla
segments.text: It's the accurate way to put it. So don't tell me it wouldn't have worked. Tell me we didn't try.

segments.speaker: Sami
segments.text: All right. We didn't try. That doesn't make it better.

segments.speaker: Layla
segments.text: No. But it makes it ours.

gist_question.q: What does Layla finally get Sami to accept?
gist_question.q_ar: ليلى خلّت سامي يعترف بإيه في الآخر؟
options: That speaking up in April would certainly have worked
That they did not try, rather than that trying would have failed
That Hana was the one responsible

questions.q: What does Sami say would have happened if they had spoken up in April?
questions.q_ar: سامي قال إيه اللي كان هيحصل لو اتكلموا في أبريل؟
options: The project would have been cancelled
They would have been replaced, and Hana would have signed the same thing
The board would have opened an investigation

questions.q: What had Sami said in the car park?
options: That the numbers were too clean
That they should go to the board
That Layla should check the file

questions.q: Which distinction does Sami insist on?
options: Between what they actually knew back in April and what they know now
Between 'wouldn't have mattered' and 'wouldn't have worked'

questions.q: What does Layla say 'let's see what the second quarter looks like' was really for?
questions.q_ar: ليلى قالت إن جملة 'نشوف الربع التاني' كانت لإيه فعلًا؟
options: Gathering all the evidence they would eventually need
Avoiding knowing for another three months
Giving Hana time to review the file
